args.question: What is the cardholder statement on this transaction?
Has any new evidence or cardholder detail arrived?

args.reason: Card reported lost or stolen; no delivery proof, which this reason code requires.

args.explanation: Mastercard 4863 chargeback; cardholder said the card was lost or stolen. The merchant had a receipt, authorisation record and prior undisputed history but no delivery proof, which the reason code requires. Nothing new appeared after 10 days, so I accepted the chargeback. Cost is the USD 369.19 sale plus the USD 15 chargeback fee.
